title: Stop repeated rescheduling of Dataverse synch jobs on bulk changes
summary: The Dataverse synchronization job reschedule logic now checks both the scheduled task's next run time and the job queue entry's earliest start date to avoid repeated rescheduling during bulk changes, reducing unnecessary Service Bus costs.
key_points: Added guard check for job queue entry's earliest start date in addition to scheduled task's next run time
Job queue entries are now locked before calling SetTaskReady to serialize concurrent reschedules
Extracted reschedule logic into testable internal procedure RescheduleJobQueueEntriesForTable
Production telemetry showed hundreds of reschedule messages per second that have been eliminated
Tests added to verify correct rescheduling behavior and detect stale task scheduler state
quote: If the job is already due within the reschedule window, skip it.
